title: Product Marketing Manger
description:
### The Role

We're looking for a Lead Product Marketing Manager to own how VectorShift's product shows up in the world. You'll sit at the intersection of product, sales, and the market — turning a fast-moving, technically deep platform into stories, materials, and moments that make people _get it_ and want it.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll set the product marketing strategy and execute against it directly,. The through-line of everything you do: taking something technical and making it land with audiences who don't live in the weeds of AI infrastructure.

### What You'll Do

**Product releases & launches.** Own the narrative and go-to-market for new features and products — write the release notes, launch blogs, changelogs, and announcement copy. Coordinate launches across product, sales, and social so every release lands with impact instead of slipping out quietly.

**Demo paths & product storytelling.** Design the demo flows and narratives that show VectorShift at its best — the "aha" sequences that turn a curious prospect into a believer. Partner with sales and solutions to make sure the story we tell matches the product they experience.

**Sales enablement & materials.** Build the collateral that helps sales win: one-pagers, pitch decks, battle cards, case studies, competitive positioning, and ROI narratives. Keep it current as the product and market evolve.

**Social & top-of-funnel content.** Drive our social presence and content engine — posts, threads, short-form explainers, and campaigns that build awareness and pull people into the funnel.

**Translate technical → non-technical.** This is the heartbeat of the role. Take complex capabilities (RAG, agentic workflows, integrations, the SDK) and make them clear, compelling, and obviously valuable to business buyers, operators, and non-technical decision-makers.

**Positioning & messaging.** Own our core positioning, value propositions, and messaging framework — and make sure it's consistent across the website, sales, product, and social.

**Market & competitive intelligence.** Stay close to customers, competitors, and the broader AI landscape, and feed those insights back into product and GTM strategy.

### What We're Looking For

* 2+ years in product marketing, with a track record of owning launches and GTM for technical products (developer tools, AI/ML, or B2B SaaS/infrastructure strongly preferred).
* Exceptional writer and storyteller — you can go from a dense technical spec to a crisp, persuasive narrative, and you have samples to prove it.
* Demonstrated ability to make technical concepts accessible to non-technical audiences.
* Comfortable operating with autonomy in a fast-moving startup — you'll define process where none exists and ship without a lot of scaffolding.
* Strong cross-functional partner who can work shoulder-to-shoulder with product, sales, and founders.
* Experience building sales enablement materials and running product launches end to end.
* Bonus: hands-on curiosity about AI tooling — you like actually _using_ the product, not just marketing it.

title: Global Startup and Venture Program Lead
description:
Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 4,700 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at [amplitude.com](http://amplitude.com).

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

**Amplitude’s Commitment to Diversity Equity & Inclusion (DEI):** Amplitude believes that diversity enables the creation of better products, improves the ability to solve complex problems, and drives more powerful solutions. We strive to create an environment of inclusion—one focused on psychological safety, empathy, and human connection—that will allow employees of all backgrounds to thrive.

**About The Role & Team**

As an AI analytics company, Amplitude partners with AI native startups to help them move faster from insight to product market fit and from product market fit to scale. Startups are a critical driver of our ecosystem and growth strategy. Our mission is to create new pathways for founders to discover Amplitude and adopt it early in their growth journey.

We are looking for a strategic, ecosystem-driven leader to run and evolve Amplitude’s Global Startup and Venture Program. This person will shape how we engage founders, partner with VCs and incubators, and position Amplitude as the platform of choice for AI native startups worldwide. You will become an indispensable resource for founders navigating product market fit and growth, and a trusted partner across the AI startup ecosystem.

 **As a Global Startup and Venture Program Lead, you will:** 

* **Lead the Startup and Venture Strategy-** Own and scale the Amplitude for Startups program while building strategic relationships with VCs, accelerators, and ecosystem partners to drive global adoption among AI native startups.
* **Drive Founder Engagement and Ecosystem Presence-** Design and execute a founder-focused engagement strategy, including high-impact events and community initiatives, to position Amplitude as the trusted AI analytics partner for startups.
* **Represent Amplitude in Key Startup Markets –** Travel regularly to attend and host events primarily in San Francisco and New York, with select international engagements, to strengthen founder relationships, deepen venture partnerships, and expand Amplitude’s presence within priority ecosystems.
* **Own Activation and Growth-** Optimize the startup web experience and activation journey, partnering with product and marketing teams to deliver a strong customer experience and support.
* **Drive Cross Functional Impact-** Align startup initiatives with Product, Sales, and Marketing by building scalable program frameworks, defining success metrics, and ensuring insights from founders inform company strategy.
* **Event Strategy and Support -** Build our event model for startups, working with team on topics, presentations and execution. Support on the ground when needed
* **Lead and Develop the Team -** Manage and develop a Startup Marketing Specialist and contractor while building processes that enable efficient, scalable execution.

**You'll be a great addition to the team if you have:**

* 6+  years of experience in startups, venture capital, ecosystem partnerships, or growth programs
* Established relationships within the Bay Area VC and startup community
* Strong understanding of founder needs, product market fit challenges, and early-stage growth dynamics
* Experience building and scaling strategic programs that drive measurable adoption
* Demonstrated success in designing and running high-impact events and community initiatives
* Deep interest in AI native ecosystems and emerging technology trends
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to craft compelling narratives for founders and investors
* Analytical mindset with experience defining program metrics and reporting on business impact
* Comfortable operating cross-functionally and influencing across Product, Sales, and Marketing
* A builder’s mindset with the ability to move quickly, think strategically, and execute thoughtfully
* Ability to travel \~10-15% of the time to Amplitude, partner, and industry events

## Who We Are

**The Company:** Amplitude is filled with humble, life-long learners who are eager to help one another and the company succeed. Our values of growth mindset, ownership, and humility are core to the way we work: we’re tenacious in the face of challenges, we take the initiative to solve problems that drive our shared success, and we operate from a place of empathy and openness, seeking to understand many points of view. 

**The Product:** Amplitude is a digital analytics platform—we help companies capture data they can trust, uncover clear insights about customer behavior, and take faster action. This empowers teams to build better product experiences that drive business growth. We’re super proud of what we’ve built and continue to expand: a platform that empowers companies to thrive in the digital era.

**We care about the well-being of our team:** We offer competitive pay and benefits packages that reflect our commitment to the health and well-being of our Ampliteers.

Some of our benefit programs include:

* Excellent ​Medical, ​Dental, and ​Vision insurance coverages, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employee ​Medical, ​Dental,​ ​​​​​​​​Vision on select plans
* Flexible time off, ​p​aid holidays, and more
* Generous stipends to spend on what matters most to you, whether that’s wellness (monthly), commuter transit/parking (monthly), learning and development (quarterly), home office equipment (annual), and much more
* Excellent Parental benefits including​:​ 12-20 weeks of Paid Parental Leave, Carrot Fertility Benefits/Adoption/Surrogacy support, Back-up Child Care support 
* Mental health and wellness benefits including no cost employee access to Modern Health coaching & therapy Sessions and high quality physician office experience via One Medical membership (select U.S. locations only)
* Employee Stock Purchase Program​ (ESPP)​

**Other fun facts about Amplitude:** 

* We were recognized in the [Newsweek Excellence Index 2024](https://www.newsweek.com/rankings/newsweek-excellence-index-2024).
* Our customers love us! They've said we're the [#1 product analytics solution](https://www.g2.com/categories/product-analytics/enterprise) for 19 quarters in a row on G2.
* We care A LOT about product innovation. Fast Company called us the #3 most innovative enterprise company in the world.
* We invest in our people. We offer mentorship programs, management training, and wellness initiatives. 
* We give back to our communities. We give every Ampliteer a charitable giving grant and paid volunteer time off. 
* We were founded in 2012, went public via a direct listing in September 2021, and are now trading under the ticker $AMPL. 
* We’re a global and fast-growing team! We have employees around the world and offices in San Francisco (HQ), New York, Vancouver, Amsterdam, London, Paris, Singapore, and Tokyo.
* Our mascot is Data Monster, who loves to chow down on numbers, charts, and graphs. Nom nom.

Amplitude provides equal employment opportunities (EEO). All applicants are considered without regards to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, or sexual orientation.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Based on legislation in California, the following details are for individuals who will work for Amplitude in San Francisco Bay Area of California. Salary range: $167,000 - $251,000 total target cash (inclusive of bonus or commission)

title: Growth (founding team) — GutGutGoose · San Francisco, in person
description:
We make personalized probiotics. People who try it come back and tell their friends, so we're growing fast every month. We've realized when people have heard of us and used us they love us — we just need to get in front of more people. That's the job.

There's no playbook to hand you — building it is the work. In practice it looks like throwing the event, printing posters and getting them somewhere people will actually see them, DMing the artist, and sitting across from an influencer or a B2B buyer until they say yes. You'll try a bunch of things every week, most won't work, and you'll find the couple that do and go hard on them.

We're starting this as a one-week trial in SF, paid at SF minimum wage, beginning whenever you can. On September 20, whoever clearly moved the needle gets a full-time offer: $120K+ salary, real equity, and a $10K signing bonus. A week working together tells us both more than any interview, and you get to see what you'd actually be signing up for.

You'll be good at this if you're in the Bay Area, want to be out in the city making things happen rather than working from home, and you're the person who books the thing instead of just suggesting it. If you can walk up to a stranger and leave with a yes, and you'd rather do something scrappy today than something perfect next week, we want to talk. We don't care about your degree or whether you've had "growth" in a job title.

Apply and tell us about the scrappiest thing you've ever done to get people to show up or care. If it's good, we'll get you in this week.

title: Performance Marketing Specialist
description:
**Full Time | In-Office**

**Location:** New York, NY\
**Salary:** Flexible based on experience and includes **performance-based components tied to acquisition performance and customer growth**.

### **About Corgi**

Corgi is building the infrastructure for the next generation of insurance. We are a technology company using AI, automation, and modern infrastructure to rethink how insurance is built, distributed, and operated.

We are a fast-moving company where teams are expected to take ownership, move quickly, and constantly improve how we do things.

We are looking for a **Performance Marketing Specialist** to own and improve Corgi's paid advertising engine.

This is **not a social media manager role or traditional brand marketing position**. We need someone who understands paid acquisition and enjoys looking at the numbers, identifying what is working, and continuously optimizing performance.

Ideally, you can also **design the ads yourself** rather than relying entirely on outside designers.

### **The Role**

You will be responsible for the day-to-day performance and creative development of Corgi's paid advertising campaigns.

You will work across the full advertising cycle:

**Create → Launch → Measure → Optimize → Test → Scale**

You will analyze campaign performance, identify opportunities, develop new creative, run experiments, and continuously improve cost per lead and overall acquisition performance.

This is a hands-on role. We are looking for someone who wants to actually get into the ad platforms, build campaigns, design creative, read the data, and figure out what works.

### **What You'll Do**

* Manage and optimize paid advertising campaigns across platforms such as Meta, Google, YouTube, and other relevant channels.
* Monitor campaign performance, budgets, conversion rates, cost per lead, and other key acquisition metrics.
* Continuously optimize campaigns based on performance data.
* Develop and test new ad concepts, messaging, formats, audiences, and landing-page approaches.
* Design advertisements and other marketing creative yourself.
* Create variations of existing creative to systematically test different hooks, headlines, visuals, layouts, and calls to action.
* Identify underperforming campaigns and diagnose why they are underperforming.
* Scale campaigns and creative that are producing strong results.
* Build structured A/B testing programs.
* Track performance and maintain clear reporting on what is working and what is not.
* Work with the broader Corgi team to improve the path from advertisement → lead → customer.
* Analyze lead quality, not simply lead volume.
* Help develop a repeatable creative testing and optimization process.
* Research competitors and advertising trends for ideas worth testing.
* Stay current on changes to advertising platforms, targeting capabilities, attribution, and creative best practices.
* Coordinate with outside vendors when additional production or specialized expertise is needed.

### **What We're Looking For**

We're less concerned with whether your previous title was "Performance Marketing Manager" and more concerned with whether **you know how to make advertising work**.

You should have:

* Experience running or optimizing paid digital advertising campaigns.
* Strong analytical instincts and comfort working with performance data.
* A/B testing experience and an understanding of conversion optimization.
* Experience with Meta Ads and/or Google Ads.
* Strong attention to detail.
* The ability to look at campaign data and turn it into concrete action.
* An understanding of how creativity affects advertising performance.
* Strong visual and design instincts.
* The ability to create, modify, and iterate on advertising creative yourself.
* A highly iterative mindset—you should naturally want to test version B when version A works.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple campaigns and experiments simultaneously.

Ideally, You Can Also:

* Work comfortably in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, or similar design tools.
* Edit short-form video for advertisements.
* Build landing pages or work with someone who does.
* Understand basic attribution and conversion tracking.
* Work with pixels, events, UTMs, and analytics platforms.
* Understand direct-response advertising and lead generation.
* Have experience with financial services, insurance, technology, or other performance-driven businesses.
* Have experience taking a campaign from initial concept through significant scale.

### **What This Role Is Not**

This is **not**:

* Influencer marketing.
* Community management.
* PR.
* Brand partnerships.
* A role primarily focused on organic social media.
* A role where an agency does all of the advertising work for you.

We are specifically looking for someone who wants to **own paid acquisition performance and creative optimization**.

### **Why Corgi**

You will have significant ownership over a critical part of the business.

There is no enormous marketing department or rigid corporate structure between you and the results. If you have an idea, you can test it. If something is working, you can scale it. If something is broken, you can fix it.

You'll work closely with the Corgi team and have the opportunity to build and shape our advertising function from the ground up.

**If you are the kind of person who looks at an ad and immediately starts thinking about how you could make it convert better, we'd like to meet you.**

# **about us**  

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our [**principles**](https://principles.telli.com/) to see how we work.

As the **Product Marketing Manager** you are the counterpart to the founder team on product & brand communication. You own how existing and potential customers hear about new features, functionalities, and telli's value proposition as a whole from product launches, to enabling our commercial teams, to everything we say about the product on our website.

- **Own product messaging & positioning:** you are the product messaging counterpart to the founder team. You create and maintain our core messaging and positioning

- **Lead product launches:** you own the go-to-market for new products and features across every medium and channel

- **Enable sales, deployment & success:** you build the decks, docs, and materials our commercial teams need to communicate what the product does and how telli is unique

- **Build customer proof:** you own our social proof. You organize customer stories in written and video form, execute them, and take care of distribution

- **Own website & product content:** you own product messaging and positioning on our website and keep product pages, ads and content up to date and aligned with our core product and brand messaging

- **Own market intelligence:** you understand the market, our positioning, and our differentiation — and you are the one who articulates it

# **what makes you a great fit:**

- **You have 3+ years of experience in product marketing in a B2B context** , ideally in a startup or scaleup

- **You have taste:** you convey telli and its features in a trustworthy, high-end, visionary way that matches our vision and mission

- **You're an excellent communicator and translator:** you write and speak at a high standard in German and English, and you turn complex features and technical concepts into language customers actually understand

- **You adapt to our customer group:** you meet our market where it is: their priorities and the way they communicate

- **You're AI-pilled:** you understand technology deeply and approach problems with an automation- and tech-first mindset

- **You have commercial sense:** you understand the business priorities and translate them into your own work

- **You work autonomously:** you don't wait for instructions and find your own strategy to be successful

- **You have high agency and high urgency:** you don't get blocked by outside factors, you unblock yourself and your team, and you focus every day on getting customers live, successful, and growing

- You want to work **on-site 5 days a week** in **Berlin**

## **you may** _ **not** _ **be a good fit if…**

- You need a brief, a brand book, and sign-off before you execute anything

- You only want to do high-level “strategic” work

- you aren’t comfortable juggling multiple tasks at once

- you don’t enjoy working directly with customers or in dynamic environments

- You aren't comfortable working at a high standard in both German and English

- You want to work remotely. We're an in-person team

- You are looking for a standard 9-5 job

description:
### About Educato

Educato is a YC-backed AI exam-prep company helping students study more effectively through personalized learning plans, practice questions, mock exams, and AI tutoring. We are building a creator-led growth engine market by market. We’re looking for someone to own our UGC creator program in Romania.

### About the role

You will own the day-to-day operation of Educato’s UGC program in Romania.\
\
Your job is to find promising Romanian creators, recruit and onboard them, get their content live, manage their campaigns, and identify which creators and formats perform best.\
\
You will work closely with Educato’s global growth and creative teams. We will provide proven formats, scripts, creative direction, tools, and campaign infrastructure. You will adapt them to Romanian culture, communicate them clearly to creators, and ensure strong execution.What you’ll do

### What you’ll do

* Find and recruit Romanian creators on TikTok and Instagram.
* Negotiate rates, onboard creators, and manage campaigns.
* Review content and give fast, clear feedback.
* Keep creators, deadlines, deliverables, and payments organized.

### You’re a great fit if

* You’re deeply familiar with the Romanian creator market and have strong English.
* You’re organized and communicate well.
* You get things done without needing lots of direction.
* You don’t have a 9 - 5 mentality and work well in a high pressure, high reward environment.

  \
  Experience matters less than execution.

### What we offer

* Full ownership of the Romanian creator program.
* Competitive local salary + performance bonuses.
* Creator budget, proven formats, and support from our global team.
* Significant responsibility and room to grow into larger markets.

description:
**_Growth = your taste \* a fleet of video agents \* lots of experiment._**

**_We want someone who can own this._**

### About GooseWorks

**Distribution is the hardest problem every company has.** Getting a product in front of people, over and over, in a way that works. 

Today that means an army of humans making creative, testing it, reading the numbers, and doing it again next week. It doesn't scale, and it's the single biggest tax on every consumer brand in the world.

We think that changes. The billion-dollar companies of the next decade will look different. They won't scale linearly with headcount — they'll be run by fleets of AI agents running growth.

**Gooseworks is building self-improving AI agents that run growth for consumer brands — ads, UGC, organic — end to end.**

It’s early - this is just a few months old, but we have very strong pull and are growing fast:

* **200+ paying users**
* **30,000+ ad creatives generated by our users in the last 2 months**

We're a YC company based in San Francisco, and **we run the company on agent harnesses ourselves**.

### The role

You will **own** **growth and distribution** for GooseWorks. 

Your job will be to **build the systems to scale content**, and having the **creative taste and judgement** to improve them.

More specifically, you will own:

* **Creator channels, AI-operated.** You design the niche, the format, the hooks, the content, everything and use our AI creative agent to make organic social content at SCALE.
* **Our voice on X and LinkedIn**. Not "brand content", value content and stories that get noticed.
* **The taste layer of our creative agent.** You'll teach our creative agent what "good" means. It's the highest-leverage work at this company.
* **Launches.** Narrative, assets, video, sequencing, day-of. End to end, from a blank page.

---

### What we're looking for

1. **Taste.** You know what good content looks like. You have a great sense of design. You understand what people resonate with.
2. **Proof-of-work:** We need to see that you can make short-form that performs. IG, TikTok, YouTube, etc.
3. **Technical AI video skills.** You know what it takes to make great content using AI, and you’ve already been doing it.
4. **You think in systems.** We’re not looking for someone to write content. We’re looking for someone to build the thing that does.
5. **You live inside AI agents.** Claude Code, Codex, etc. You understand what a harness is and how to build one.

**Strong preferences for:**

* **a technical background**
* **proven content creator muscle**

---

### This is a 0→1 job

That means:

* **High ownership**: You'll own channels end-to-end, whatever that might mean. You’ll have autonomy and a high degree of creative control.
* **Lots of experimentation**: You’ll try lots of things fast and double down on what works.
* **Messy problems, fast loops.** Ship daily, execute is measured in hours, not weeks.
* **You're part of the founding team.**

### You're probably not a fit if

* You’re used to working with large teams to get things done.
* You have never created awesome content.
* You have never built a content systems or agent skills / harnesses.
* You think AI-generated content can never be more than slop. (we’re looking for someone to prove the world wrong)

The engine compounds: the agent learns from ad performance, competitors, trends, and human feedback, so your creative gets better every month.

title: Marketing Lead
description:
## About Conduit

Conduit is an AI agent platform purpose-built for hospitality. Hotels, vacation rentals, and resorts deploy our agents across guest-facing communication and internal operations, running millions of workflows a day.

Hospitality is 10% of global GDP and it turns on customer experience. Resolving a guest request immediately is most of that experience, and resolving one means moving across several tools and between several people. That coordination is the work, and it is what our agents do.

## Role: Marketing Lead

You own the end-to-end marketing lifecycle, product marketing and demand generation both. This is a marketing lead role where you are also deep in the work, doing it yourself.

### Why this role is different

One person plus AI leverage is the expectation. You will not have a team on day one. The bet is that one strong operator with AI covers what used to take a team, and you build the team from those results.

### What the work looks like

* Positioning, and the marketing site. Building out pages, including solutions pages.
* Video and use cases.
* Webinars.
* Competitor analysis, for hotels and generally.
* Blog, and the design assets that go with it.
* Media franchises. Experiments with newsletters, podcasts, and influencer marketing.
* Field marketing. Citywide campaigns, in-person events, gifting, dinners, and conferences.
* The founders’ LinkedIn, and the strategy behind it.
* Paid ads, including creative.
* Signup funnel flows.
* Turning a small lead flow into a machine, with tight targeting.

### Who you are

* B2B SaaS or an AI company preferred. No hospitality background required.
* Preferred if you have led a high-performing marketing team before, at a fast-growing company running a lot of marketing experiments.
* Comfortable across push and pull. Outbound, events, and field on one side; SEO, LinkedIn, and case studies on the other.

title: Marketing Internship
description:
**Location:** In-person, San Francisco — ASAP\
**Type:** Internship

Overlap builds AI video agents for media companies. We help teams automatically edit and post the best moments from long-form video and audio.

We work with customers including iHeartMedia, Barstool Sports, Yahoo, Almost Friday, The Volume, ARN, NZME, and many others. Together, our customers represent a major share of the podcast publishing and digital media space.

## The Role

We’re looking for a **Marketing Intern** who wants real ownership over how Overlap shows up in the world.

You’ll run social, develop creative campaigns, help produce events, and come up with your own initiatives to grow the Overlap brand. This is not a role where you’ll be handed a calendar and asked to schedule posts. We want someone who has ideas, good taste, and the ability to turn those ideas into things people actually see.

You should understand internet culture, know what makes content interesting, and have strong instincts for how a fast-moving AI company should communicate. You’ll work directly with the founders and have significant freedom to experiment.

## What You’ll Do

* Turn product launches, customer wins, company milestones, and interesting ideas into compelling content
* Own and grow Overlap’s presence across X, LinkedIn, Instagram, TikTok, and other relevant channels
* Develop and execute creative marketing campaigns from concept → production → distribution
* Create social graphics, short-form videos, launch assets, and other creative
* Help plan and execute events, activations, dinners, conferences, and community initiatives
* Work with customers and partners on co-marketing opportunities
* Find unconventional ways to get Overlap in front of the right people
* Pitch and own your own marketing initiatives with the resources to execute them
* Experiment constantly, measure what works, and double down quickly

## What We’re Looking For

* Exceptional taste and a strong sense for what looks, sounds, and feels good
* Deep familiarity with social media and internet culture
* Strong writing and communication skills
* Ability to take an idea from a blank page to something shipped
* Creative instincts beyond simply following existing marketing playbooks
* High agency — you see something that should exist and make it happen
* Comfortable moving quickly without perfect instructions
* Willingness to work in-person in San Francisco

## Bonus Points

* You’ve grown a social account, newsletter, community, or personal brand
* You’ve created content that has meaningfully spread online
* Experience with Figma, Photoshop, Premiere, After Effects, CapCut, or similar creative tools
* Experience organizing events or activations
* Familiarity with AI, media, podcasts, creators, or startups
* You have a portfolio of weird, interesting, or ambitious things you’ve made

## Why Join Overlap

* Take real ownership of marketing at a high-growth YC-backed AI startup
* Build a brand alongside some of the largest media companies in the world
* Have the freedom to launch your own campaigns and initiatives
* Work directly with the founders with very little bureaucracy
* Experiment constantly and see the results of your work immediately
* Join a small team where a great idea can become a company-wide initiative the same day

## Apply

**Send us things you’ve made.**

We care much more about taste, creativity, and demonstrated ability than credentials. Send us campaigns, videos, social accounts, designs, events, side projects, writing, or anything else that shows how you think and what you can create.

title: GTM Intern
description:
We're looking for an gtm intern who is technically strong, learns fast, and wants to help grow the business. This isn't a "shadow someone for 12 weeks" internship. You'll ship projects, talk to customers and maintain a high level of autonomy in the process.

**What you'd work on**

\- Create content, how-to guides, and useful posts to share on social media. 

\- Work with the engineering team and founders daily

**What we're looking for**

\- Fast rate of learning

\- High agency

\- Comfortable with ambiguity

\- Excited to work hard and move fast

\- Curious, resourceful, low ego

**Strong signals**

\- You've built side projects, internal tools, or open-source contributions

\- You enjoy ownership and actively seek responsibility

\- Comfortable reading and working across multiple languages and systems

\- You've done something technically impressive relative to your experience level. We care about raw ability, not polish

**Probably not a fit if**

\- You want a lot of structure and clearly scoped tasks

\- You're uncomfortable figuring things out without detailed guidance

\- You want a big-company internship experience with formal mentorship programs

\---

With early enterprise traction, we are well positioned to be the default reliability platform of the future.
